contexts.text: A chequered vest () = the Divine truth there which proceeds immediately from the Divine Celestial... It is called chequered because it was woven...

Thou shalt chequer the vest of linen () = the inmost things of the Spiritual Kingdom which proceed from the truths of celestial love... Of this vest it is said that it was to be chequered, and by what is chequered is meant the work of the weaver, and by the work of the weaver is signified that which is from the Celestial; the same word which in the Original Language expresses to chequer, also means to weave.
The Lord's vest having been without seam and woven from above throughout has a similar signification to the chequering or weaving of Aaron's vest.
